claims.text: At stage-1, OrdersController's GET /api/v1/orders/{id} reads the order through IOrderRepository.FindAsync and maps order.Items to the response; without the Include, Items stays the empty list Order starts with (`= []`), so the order comes back with no items.

claims.text: An integration test runs code together with a real dependency it talks to (e.g. EfOrderRepository against a real PostgreSQL database) instead of a test double.

FakeOrderRepository keeps orders in a Dictionary<int, Order>; AddAsync stores the object it receives and FindAsync returns that same object (GetValueOrDefault), so Items is whatever the caller filled in.

With Include, EF Core reads order_items in the same query; without it the order row is read alone and Items stays the empty list Order creates, unless the same DbContext already tracks those items. AddDbContext registers DonHangDbContext scoped: a new one per request.
claims.source_hint: refs efcore-docs querying/related-data/eager.md (TIP on fix-up); stage-1 ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:14 AddDbContext (scoped); Entities.cs:31

claims.text: At stage-1 DonHang.Tests.csproj has a ProjectReference to DonHang.Domain only, so DonHang.Infrastructure (EfOrderRepository) is not part of the test build and no test runs its query.
The migration AddOrderCustomerNavigation (20260924092625) adds the foreign key FK_orders_customers_customer_id on orders.customer_id referencing customers.id.
PostgreSQL refuses to insert a row whose foreign key column names no row in the referenced table (foreign key violation).

An integration test against PostgreSQL needs a running database and is slower than a test with a fake, so it is worth writing for what only the real dependency can show, not to repeat rules a unit test already checks.

EfOrderRepository at stage-1 implements IOrderRepository; FindAsync is `db.Orders.Include(o => o.Items).FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.Id == id)` (line 10) and SaveChangesAsync calls db.SaveChangesAsync().
A manual check by hand is not repeated on every change; an automated test is.
In a stage-1 checkout, `dotnet test DonHang.Tests` reports 5 passed; after removing `.Include(o => o.Items)` from FindAsync (line 10) it still reports 5 passed.
